en.headline: Food safety centre orders stop-sale of chilled shrimp batch
en.dek: A pre-packaged sample from a North Point shop contained a trace of a banned veterinary-drug metabolite, and the distributor has started a recall.
body: The Centre for Food Safety said on Monday night that a pre-packaged chilled shrimp sample had tested positive for a trace of a metabolite of furazolidone, a banned veterinary drug in the nitrofuran group. The centre told the public to stop eating the affected batch and told traders holding it to stop using or selling it.

The sample was taken from a fresh-food shop in North Point under the centre's routine food surveillance programme. The product is peeled white shrimp meat, listed as coming from the mainland and distributed by Lung Shun Global Seafood Trading Company Limited. Test results showed a nitrofuran metabolite level of 6.1 parts per billion.

The centre said it had informed the shop of the breach and ordered the affected batch off the shelves. The distributor had begun a recall of that batch as instructed. The centre said it would notify the trade, keep following the case and take appropriate action.

Two local newsrooms reporting the centre's notice also listed the pack weight as 200 grams and a best-before date of 22 January 2028. The centre's own statement, as carried by RTHK, identified the product name, origin and distributor, and the instruction to stop sale.

zh.headline: 食安中心指令停售一批去腸白蝦仁
zh.dek: 北角一新鮮糧食店的預先包裝冷藏蝦肉驗出微量禁用獸藥代謝物，分銷商已按指示回收受影響批次。
body: 食物安全中心星期一晚公布，一個預先包裝冷藏蝦肉樣本驗出微量禁用獸藥呋喃唑酮代謝物。呋喃唑酮屬硝基呋喃類。中心呼籲市民停止食用受影響批次，業界如持有該批次，亦應立即停止使用或出售。
樣本是中心透過恆常食物監測計劃，在北角一間新鮮糧食店抽取。產品名稱為去腸白蝦仁，來源地為內地，分銷商是隆順環球海產貿易有限公司。檢測結果顯示，硝基呋喃類代謝物含量為十億分之6.1。
中心說已通知有關商戶違規事項，並指令將受影響批次停售和下架。分銷商已按指示展開回收。中心會通知業界，繼續跟進並採取適當行動。
本港兩間傳媒引述中心資料，指該批次重量為200克，此日期前最佳為2028年1月22日。香港電台引述的中心說法，則確認了產品名稱、來源地、分銷商，以及停售下架的指令。
